definition_zh: 比例；部分；份额；均衡；相称；（数学）比例式；大小、规模
definition_en: the relation between parts, or between a part and the whole, in size, amount, or importance
core_image: 一块蛋糕被切成大小不同的几份，每一份与整块之间都有固定的比
scene: 建筑师在图纸上反复比较窗户与墙面。If the window is too large the wall looks light and unstable, so the proportion of glass to brick has to be judged by eye.
sceneCN: 这里 proportion 是「比例、相称」（第 2 个义项：各部之间在大小上的关系）；句意：窗太大墙面就显得轻浮不稳，所以玻璃与砖的比例只能靠眼睛来把握。图中可辨识物件：建筑立面图、窗户、墙面分区、比例尺、铅笔。

pos.zh: 比例；部分；份额；均衡；规模

senses.title: A part relative to the whole
senses.definition: a part considered in relation to the whole amount
senses.definitionCN: 相对于整体而言的一部分
senses.example: A large proportion of students commute.
senses.exampleCN: 很大比例的学生通勤。
senses.why: Latin proportio joins pro- 'according to' to portio 'share'. The word begins with shares: one part measured against the whole it belongs to.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 proportio 把 pro-“按照”与 portio“份额”结合。这个词始于份额：一部分相对于它所属的整体被衡量。

senses.title: The relation between parts
senses.definition: the comparative size or amount of two or more parts
senses.definitionCN: 两个或多个部分在大小或数量上的对比关系
senses.example: The proportion of sugar to flour matters.
senses.exampleCN: 糖与面粉的比例很关键。
senses.why: Two parts can be compared without a whole: this is the relational core. Cooking, chemistry, and design all depend on the ratio between ingredients.
senses.whyCN: 两部分可以脱离整体比较：这是关系性的核心。烹饪、化学与设计都依赖配料之间的比率。

senses.title: Correct balance or harmony
senses.definition: the quality of parts fitting together well
senses.definitionCN: 各部分彼此协调得当的性质
senses.example: The room has a pleasing sense of proportion.
senses.exampleCN: 这个房间有种悦目的比例感。
senses.why: Aesthetics evaluates the relation: some ratios look right, others jar. Proportion becomes a judgment, not just a measurement.
senses.whyCN: 美学评估这种关系：某些比率看起来对，另一些则刺眼。proportion 于是成了判断，而不只是测量。

senses.title: An equal share (archaic)
senses.definition: in older usage, a share allotted to each person
senses.definitionCN: 旧用法：分给每个人的一份
senses.example: Each heir received a proportion of the estate.
senses.exampleCN: 每位继承人分得遗产的一份。
senses.why: The oldest sense is the simple share: portio is a portion. The mathematical sense grew from comparing such shares.
senses.whyCN: 最古老的义项是简单的份额：portio 就是一份。数学义从比较这些份额生长出来。

senses.title: An equation of ratios (mathematics)
senses.definition: a statement that two ratios are equal
senses.definitionCN: 两个比率相等的陈述
senses.example: Solve the proportion 3/4 = x/12.
senses.why: Mathematics formalizes the comparison: a proportion asserts an equality between two ratios. The word keeps its 'share' root even in algebra.
senses.whyCN: 数学把比较形式化：比例式断言两个比率的相等。即使在代数中，这个词仍保留“份额”词根。

senses.title: Direct or inverse proportion
senses.definition: a relationship in which one quantity changes at a fixed rate with another
senses.definitionCN: 一个量随另一个量按固定比率变化的关系
senses.example: Speed is in direct proportion to distance over time.
senses.exampleCN: 速度与距离除以时间成正比。
senses.why: Science uses proportion for lawful co-variation: as one rises, the other rises or falls by a fixed factor. The ratio becomes a law of nature.
senses.whyCN: 科学用 proportion 指有规律的共变：一个上升，另一个按固定倍数上升或下降。比率成了自然法则。

senses.title: Size or dimensions
senses.definition: the size or scale of something, especially its relative dimensions
senses.definitionCN: 某物的大小或尺度，尤指相对维度
senses.example: The sculpture has heroic proportions.
senses.exampleCN: 这座雕塑体量宏伟。
senses.why: Proportions in the plural name the measured dimensions of a body or building. The relation becomes the thing itself: a person of large proportions.
senses.whyCN: 复数 proportions 命名身体或建筑被量出的维度。关系变成了事物本身：a person of large proportions。

senses.title: Proportional representation
senses.definition: an electoral system in which seats are allotted in proportion to votes
senses.definitionCN: 按得票比例分配席位的选举制度
senses.example: The party favors proportional representation.
senses.exampleCN: 该党支持比例代表制。
senses.why: Politics applies the ratio to power: votes are shares, and seats should mirror them. The word becomes a principle of fairness.
senses.whyCN: 政治把比率用于权力：选票是份额，席位应映照它们。这个词成了一种公平原则。

senses.title: Analogy or relation (archaic)
senses.definition: in older usage, a correspondence or analogy between things
senses.definitionCN: 旧用法：事物之间的对应或类比关系
senses.example: The proportion between microcosm and macrocosm was a medieval theme.
senses.exampleCN: 小宇宙与大宇宙的对应是中世纪的主题。
senses.why: Old philosophy used proportion for cosmic correspondences, not just numbers. The word could mean 'analogy', which is why proportionality once carried metaphysical weight.
senses.whyCN: 旧哲学用 proportion 指宇宙对应，而非只是数字。这个词曾可指“类比”，所以 proportional 一度带有形而上学分量。

intro.en: Proportion is a share word before it is a math word. Latin proportio joins pro- 'according to' with portio 'share', so it names the relation between allotments. Mathematics later made that relation exact.
intro.cn: proportion 先是份额词，然后才是数学词。拉丁语 proportio 把 pro-“按照”与 portio“份额”结合，因此它命名分配物之间的关系。数学后来把这种关系精确化。

items.en: First recorded as 'relation, correspondence, comparative share', from Latin proportio.
items.cn: 最早记录为“关系、对应、比较中的份额”，来自拉丁语 proportio。

items.en: proportio(nem) 'comparative relation, analogy' = pro- 'according to, for' + portio 'a share, a part'.
items.cn: proportio(nem)“比较关系、类比”= pro-“按照、为了”+ portio“份额、部分”。

items.en: portio 'a share' also gives portion, apportion, and proportion. The family is about dividing something into parts.
items.cn: portio“份额”还生成 portion、apportion、proportion。这个词族关乎把某物分成部分。

items.en: Here pro- does not mean 'forward' as in proceed or project; it means 'according to, in relation to'. The same prefix has several senses.
items.cn: 此处 pro- 不表示 proceed 或 project 中的“向前”，而表示“按照、相对于”。同一前缀有多种含义。

items.en: The mathematical and aesthetic senses become precise: proportion in geometry, and proportion in art and architecture.
items.cn: 数学与美学义变得精确：几何中的比例，以及艺术与建筑中的比例。

items.en: Modern English uses proportion for shares, ratios, balance, size, and electoral systems, all tracing back to portio.
items.cn: 现代英语用 proportion 指份额、比率、均衡、规模与选举制度，全部追溯到 portio。

note.en: The first group shares the portio stem; the second is about nouns that also mean a ratio or a share.
note.cn: 第一组共享 portio 词干，第二组看同样表示“比率”或“份额”的名词。

entries.definition: a share or piece of something. It is the simple noun behind proportion.
entries.definitionCN: 一份或一块。它是 proportion 背后的简单名词。

entries.definition: changing at a fixed ratio with something else.
entries.definitionCN: 与某物按固定比率变化的。

entries.definition: to divide and distribute shares. It is ad- 'to' + portio.
entries.definitionCN: 分配份额。它是 ad-“向”+ portio。

entries.definition: the numerical relation between two quantities. It is the measured form of proportion.
entries.definitionCN: 两个数量之间的数值关系。它是 proportion 的测量形式。

entries.definition: a portion given to one person. It names the piece, not the relation between pieces.
entries.definitionCN: 分给一个人的一份。它命名那块，而非块与块的关系。

entries.definition: an even distribution of parts or forces. It matches the aesthetic sense.
entries.definitionCN: 部分或力量的均衡分布。它对应美学义。

normalIntro.en: Real links: Latin portio 'share', pro- 'according to', the portion/apportion family, and the phrases in proportion to and out of proportion.
normalIntro.cn: 真实联系：拉丁语 portio“份额”、pro-“按照”、portion/apportion 词族，以及 in proportion to / out of proportion 两个短语。

normal.en: Portio means 'share'. Proportion is the relation between shares: this part against that part, or part against whole.
normal.cn: portio 意为“份额”。proportion 是份额之间的关系：这份对那份，或部分对整体。

normal.en: Here pro- means 'according to', not 'forward'. Proportion is measured according to the shares.
normal.cn: 此处 pro- 意为“按照”，不是“向前”。proportion 是按份额来衡量的。

normal.en: In proportion to means a fixed ratio holds; out of proportion means the ratio has broken, often in emotion.
normal.cn: in proportion to 意为固定比率成立；out of proportion 意为比率破裂，常用于情绪。

normal.en: A sense of proportion is a sense of relative size: knowing what matters how much.
normal.cn: a sense of proportion 是对相对大小的感觉：知道什么值多少。

normal.en: Proportional representation makes seats mirror votes: the political version of the same ratio.
normal.cn: 比例代表制让席位映照选票：同一比率在政治中的版本。

abstract.en: Proportion is how meaning is made from relation: nothing is large or small except against something else.
abstract.cn: 比例是从关系生成意义的方式：没有东西是大或小，除非相对他物。

abstract.en: A sense of proportion is a moral skill as much as an aesthetic one: it is knowing what deserves how much attention.
abstract.cn: 分寸感既是审美技能也是道德技能：知道什么该得到多少注意。

abstract.en: The word moves from shares to ratios to justice: fair distribution and exact measurement share one root.
abstract.cn: 这个词从份额走到比率再走到正义：公平分配与精确测量共享一个词根。

examples.en: The proportion of women in the workforce has risen.
examples.cn: 女性在劳动力中的比例上升了。

examples.en: Try to keep the problem in proportion.
examples.cn: 尽量把问题看得合乎分寸。

examples.en: The two quantities are in direct proportion.
examples.cn: 这两个量成正比。

dict_mnemonic.text: “扑若剖身”——把整体扑开、剖开身子分成几份 → proportion 比例、份额

root: 拉丁语 proportio“比较关系”，由 pro-“按照”+ portio“份额”构成；portio 还生成 portion、apportion。

sensesIntro.en: Nine senses of proportion, all resting on a share. The share can be compared to the whole, to another share, to an ideal balance, to a mathematical law, to a body's size, or to a vote.
sensesIntro.cn: proportion 的九个义项都建立在“份额”上。这个份额可以相对整体、相对另一份、相对理想均衡、相对数学规律、相对身体大小，或相对选票。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: parts measured against one another and against the whole.
core.cn: 核心意象：各部分彼此衡量，也与整体衡量。

branches.en: SHARE: one part set against the whole, or allotted to one person.
branches.cn: 份额：一部分相对整体，或分给一个人。

branches.en: RATIO: parts compared with each other, in arithmetic and in natural law.
branches.cn: 比率：部分彼此比较，在算术与自然法则中皆然。

branches.en: BALANCE: the relation judged as harmonious or fitting.
branches.cn: 均衡：这种关系被判断为和谐、得当。

branches.en: SIZE AND ANALOGY: measured dimensions, and the older idea of correspondence.
branches.cn: 大小与类比：被量出的维度，以及较早的对应观念。

branches.en: POLITICS: seats allotted in proportion to votes, making the ratio a rule of justice.
branches.cn: 政治：席位按选票比例分配，使比率成为正义规则。

intro.en: Proportion is a noun from Latin proportio. English adds -al, -ate, -ality, and the negative dis-, while portio also gives portion and apportion.
intro.cn: proportion 是来自拉丁 proportio 的名词。英语加 -al、-ate、-ality 与否定 dis-，portio 还生成 portion 与 apportion。

latinIntro.en: Latin proportio 'comparative relation' joins pro- 'according to' with portio 'share'. The portio family is about dividing into parts, which is why the word can mean both a ratio and a fair share.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 proportio“比较关系”把 pro-“按照”与 portio“份额”结合。portio 词族关乎分成部分，所以这个词既能指比率，也能指公平份额。
